title: OpenAI named a Leader in enterprise coding agents by Gartner
summary: OpenAI is named a leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents, with Codex recognized for innovation and enterprise-scale deployment.
body: OpenAI is named a leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents, with Codex recognized for innovation and enterprise-scale deployment.
summaryZh: OpenAI在Gartner发布的2026年企业级AI编码智能体魔力象限（Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents）中被评为领导者，其Codex产品因创新能力和企业级规模化部署表现受到认可。
